description: Read-only code reviews, design reviews and analyses by another agent family through Cowboy managed calls.
guidance: Read-only review is optional. Before reporting, use `cowboy review` at most once per task for costly bugs your checks cannot rule out: security, permissions, concurrency, persistence/migrations, deletion, money or large refactors. Skip small, mechanical, docs, test-only and exploratory work. A user-requested review uses `cowboy review --ask`. It reads the worktree and returns findings; focus goes on stdin, options in `--help`. Fix valid findings; keep skips/missing commands silent. Other delegation: `cowboy {{peer_command}} --help`. Never launch hidden `codex exec`, `codex review` or `claude -p`.
